notes: v1.53: TWO BIG FIXES. (1) Lanes no longer appear to wait for each other — recorded events are now rebased so the first event is at t=0, killing the reaction-time lead-in that made parallel lanes look synced. Each lane fires INSTANTLY on play. (2) Events now save AGGRESSIVELY: every single captured event triggers an atomic save (.tmp + fsync + os.replace, no corruption possible), plus a 5-second safety-net autosave timer for every other edit. Stop losing your recordings.
